name: Zenobia
description: (Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)Zenobia is a Rare Blade from a Core Crystal bound to their Driver, wielding a Greataxe with the Wind Element. She has great physical ability and wind use, and grows stronger the more wounded she is as a berserker. She grants her Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, requires user energy, and scales with user strength and bond.
